application_type_full: Tree works: Trees in conservation areas/subject to TPOs
description: TPO 07/93 (T1 Twin Stem Ash tree)- Remove stem leaning over roof of house (summary)
decision_conditions:
Consent is refused for the following works:
• (T1 Twin Stem Ash tree)- Remove stem leaning over roof of house

The works requested are extreme and are not support by a significantly observable defect being identified, that requires stem removal as the only management option. This work would create a large pruning wound and point of future weakness for the remaining stem on the structure. No information has been provided relating to the union of the tree and if this is structurally acclimated to accommodate the stem lean, or if the lean is recent and requires removal due to this. It is possible that a reduction of the branch tip and crown material would be suitable to reduce any crown weight.
